decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Drawing Numbers L(-2)100, 101, 102, 103, 104; L(-2)301, 302;  L(-3)101, L(-4)102, 101, 103, 302, 302A, 301A received 19/03/13
Drawing numbers L(-4)303B, L (-2)303A received 21/05/13  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - The privacy screens/balustrades (obscured on the side) shown on the approved plans shall be erected prior to the first use of the roof terrace hereby approved and they shall be maintained as such.
description: Erection of a single storey ground floor extension with erection of railings around roof terrace on first floor level and extension of existing basement level.  Change of windows to the front and rear elevation from upvc to sash and installation of new external door at first floor level
